William Skinner）把晚期帝制中国的社会地理描绘为两套中心地等级体系的交叠（Skinner 1977: 275-352；另见 Wakeman 1985, Whitney 1970）。第一套大体上自下而上建构，从交换中产生；其相互重叠的单元，由以规模递增的城镇为中心、范围越来越大的市场区构成。第二套主要由自上而下强加，出自帝国的控制；其层层嵌套的单元构成一个行政管辖区的等级体系。直到县（hsien）一级，每一座城市在商业等级体系和行政等级体系中都有一个位置。在此之下，即便是强大的中华帝国也是通过士绅实行间接统治的。在自上而下的体系中，我们看到强制的空间逻辑；在自下而上的体系中，则是资本的空间逻辑。在欧洲国家与城市的不平等相遇中，我们已经一再看到这两套相似的等级体系在起作用。

G. William Skinner portrays the social geography of late imperial China as the intersection of two sets of central-place hierarchies (Skinner 1977: 275-352; see also Wakeman 1985, Whitney 1970). The first, constructed largely from the bottom up, emerged from exchange; its overlapping units consisted of larger and larger market areas centered on towns and cities of increasing size. The second, imposed mainly from the top down, resulted from imperial control; its nested units comprised a hierarchy of administrative jurisdictions. Down to the level of the
hsien,

or county, every city had a place in both the commercial and the administrative hierarchy. Below that level, even the mighty Chinese Empire ruled indirectly via its gentry. In the top-down system, we find the spatial logic of coercion. In the bottom-up system, the spatial logic of capital. We have seen two similar hierarchies at work repeatedly in the unequal encounter between European states and cities.

在中国的某些地区，帝国控制相对薄弱，商业活动相对强盛；在那里，城市在市场秩序中的位次通常高于其在帝国秩序中的位次。在其他地方（尤其是在帝国的边缘，这些地区对中央而言通常更多是出于安全考虑而非财政收入才有价值），帝国控制给予城市的位次高于商业活动所给予的位次。施坚雅勾画了一座城市在两套等级体系中相对位置的若干关键相关项。例如，被派往在市场等级体系中位置较高的城市的帝国行政官员，相比其在条件较差地区的同僚，更多地通过同商人及其他兴旺显贵组成的“准政治”网络打交道来完成工作；而这些主要市场城市所在的地区，则资助了数量超出其相应份额的科举考生，而科举是通向官僚生涯的途径。自上而下与自下而上两种体系的这种相互作用还带来了许多其他后果。

In some Chinese regions, imperial control was relatively weak and commercial activity relatively strong; there, cities generally occupied higher ranks in the order of markets than in the imperial order. Elsewhere (especially at the empire's periphery, where regions were typically more valuable to the center for security than for revenue), imperial control placed a city higher than did commercial activity. Skinner sketches some critical correlates of a city's relative position in the two hierarchies; for example, imperial administrators assigned to cities occupying relatively high positions in the market hierarchy accomplished more of their work by dealing with "parapolitical" networks of merchants and other prospering notables than did their colleagues in less well-favored areas, while the regions including those major market cities financed more than their share of candidates for the imperial examinations that led to careers in the bureaucracy. Many other consequences flowed from that interplay of top-down and bottom-up systems.

中国与欧洲有何不同？在1637年出版的一本小册子里，耶稣会士艾儒略（Giulio Aleni）报告说，他的中国朋友常常问起欧洲：“既然有那么多国王，你们怎么能不打仗？”他报告说，自己出于天真，或是故作天真地回答说：“欧洲的国王们都通过联姻联系在一起，因此彼此相处融洽。一旦发生战争，教皇就出面干预；他派出使节，警告交战各方停止厮杀。”（Bünger 1987: 320）这番话正说在可怕的三十年战争中间，而那场战争最终把绝大多数欧洲国家卷入了流血。这一差别至为关键：尽管中国也曾经历过一个与欧洲的国际无政府状态有许多共同之处的战国时代，尽管起义和来自边疆的入侵一再威胁帝国的控制，但大多数时候，一个单一的中心支配着中国的大片空间——按欧洲标准，那是一片大得难以想象的地带。帝国长期是中国的常态；一个帝国衰落了，另一个便取而代之。此外，在18世纪，当来自单一中心的直接统治开始在欧洲站稳脚跟时，清朝皇帝正在其全部领地上推行一种影响更为深远的直接统治；1726年，雍正皇帝甚至用自己政权的行政官员取代了中国西南少数民族的首领（Bai 1988: 197）。而在欧洲，分裂为多个相互竞争的国家，在过去整整一千年里一直占据主导。

How did China differ from Europe? In a pamphlet published in 1637, Jesuit Giuldo Aldeni reported that his Chinese friends often asked of Europe "If there are so many kings, how can you avoid wars?" He reported answering, naively or disingenuously, "The kings of Europe are all connected by marriage, and therefore live on good terms with one another. If there is a war, the Pope intervenes; he sends out envoys to warn the belligerents to stop fighting" (Bünger 1987: 320). This in the middle of the frightful Thirty Years' War, which eventually drew the vast majority of European states into the bloodletting. The difference is critical: although China had once lived through an era of Warring States that had much in common with the international anarchy of Europe, and if insurrections and invasions from the frontiers recurrently threatened imperial control, most of the time a single center dominated much of Chinese space, a zone that was unimaginably large by European standards. Empire was long China's normal condition; when one empire declined, another seized its place. During the eighteenth century, furthermore, while direct rule from a single center was beginning to take hold in Europe, Qing emperors were imposing an even more far-reaching direct rule throughout their domains; in 1726 Emperor Yongzheng went so far as to replace the chiefs of ethnic minorities in southwest China with administrators of his own regime (Bai 1988: 197). In Europe, fragmentation into multiple competing states has prevailed over all of the last millennium.

尽管俄国的沙皇最终统辖了亚洲一大片广袤地区，欧洲本身却从未容纳过一个达到中国鼎盛时期规模的帝国。然而，在罗马的疆域碎裂之后，许多统治者曾试图在欧洲建立帝国，或把帝国扩展到欧洲来。一系列穆斯林帝国曾伸入西班牙和巴尔干，但未能走得更远。拜占庭、保加利亚、塞尔维亚和奥斯曼帝国有时横跨巴尔干和中东，而蒙古人和其他亚洲入侵者则在俄罗斯留下了一份帝国遗产。在欧洲的核心地带，查理曼拼合起一个易于分裂的帝国，诺曼人几度尝试建立帝国，一个神圣罗马帝国（de jure，法理上的）和一个哈布斯堡帝国（de facto，事实上的）都让人感受到它们的存在。然而，这些帝国努力都远远未能囊括整个大陆。罗马之后，欧洲没有任何大片地区感受到另一个帝国以罗马规模、更不用说以中国规模进行的统治。

Although Russian tsars eventually commanded a huge expanse of Asia; Europe itself never hosted an empire of the scale of China's at its prime. After the fragmentation of Rome's domains, nonetheless, many rulers attempted to build empires in Europe, or to extend them into Europe. A succession of Muslim empires reached into Spain and the Balkans, but got no farther. Byzantine, Bulgarian, Serbian, and Ottoman empires sometimes straddled the Balkans and the Middle East, while Mongols and other Asian invaders left an imperial heritage in Russia. In Europe's heartlands, Charlemagne pieced together a fissiparous empire, Normans made several attempts at empire-building, and both a Holy Roman empire
(de jure)
and a Habsburg empire
(de facto)

made their presence felt. Yet these imperial efforts all fell far short of grasping the entire continent. After Rome no large section of Europe felt the rule of another empire on a Roman, much less a Chinese, scale.

然而，欧洲以自身更为碎裂的方式，经历了施坚雅在中国发现的那两种过程的相互作用：自下而上地建立以贸易和制造业为基础的区域等级体系，自上而下地强加政治控制。欧洲的城市网络代表了资本的等级体系；它们构成了商业联系的较高层级，这些联系伸入城镇和村庄，由沿途叫卖的行商（colporteurs，词源上指用肩扛运货物的人）、小贩（词源上指徒步把货物从一个地方带到另一个地方的人），以及其他更为殷实的商人——他们以通过地方性和区域性的贸易从事资本积累为业——联结起来。当一位英格兰国王或一位勃艮第公爵深入乡村索取税收和士兵时，他发现了一些早已确立的商业联系，而他在创造这些联系时几乎未起作用，也无法完全控制它们。事实上，欧洲自下而上的等级体系长期以来比其自上而下的政治控制结构更为完整、更为连贯，也更为广阔。这正是罗马之后许多次建立横跨大陆帝国的尝试归于失败的一个主要原因。

Nevertheless Europe experienced in its own more segmented way the interplay of the two processes Skinner detects in China: the bottom-up building of regional hierarchies based on trade and manufacturing, the top-down imposition of political control. Europe's urban networks represented the hierarchy of capital; they comprised the higher levels of commercial connections that reached into towns and villages, linked by
colporteurs

(etymologically, those who carried goods on their shoulders), peddlers (etymologically, those who walked their goods from place to place), and other more substantial merchants who made capital accumulation through local and regional trade their business. As an English king or a Burgundian duke reached into the countryside for taxes and soldiers, he found well-established commercial connections he had played little part in creating, and could not completely control. Indeed, Europe's bottom-up hierarchies long remained more complete, connected, and extensive than its top-down structures of political control. That was a major reason for the failure of the many post-Roman attempts to build empires spanning the continent.

王国斌（R. Bin Wong）对欧洲和中国围绕食物的斗争的比较多有提示，显示出两大洲的经历之间存在着若干重要的施坚雅式的平行之处（Wong 1983; Wong and Perdue 1983）。尽管在结构上存在重大差异，两个地区的人们似乎都特别可能在食物短缺和／或价格高涨的时候、在粮食市场交易的范围与政府对食物供给的控制程度之间差距不断扩大的地方，以强力夺取食物。那些依赖本地市场获得食物的穷人，替代了那些不能或不愿再维护本地对其范围内储存、交易或运输的食物的主张的当局。18世纪和19世纪的中国经历了帝国控制的衰退，而市场却维持原状甚至扩大，于是当地人拦截货运、胁迫商人或夺取囤积的谷物，以维护他们对供给的主张。

R. Bin Wong's comparison of struggles over food in Europe and China suggests some important Skinnerian parallels between the experiences of the two continents (Wong 1983; Wong and Perdue 1983). Despite significant differences in structure, people in both regions seem to have been especially likely to seize food forcefully in times of shortage and/or high prices where and when the gap was widening between the extent of food marketing and the degree of governmental control over food supply. Poor people who depended on local markets for their food substituted themselves for authorities who could or would no longer enforce the locality's claims to food stored, marketed, or shipped within its perimeter. Eighteenth- and nineteenth-century China experienced a decline in imperial control as markets held their own or even expanded, and local people blocked shipments, bullied merchants, or seized stored grain to enforce their claims to the supply.

就18世纪和19世纪的欧洲而言，粮食贸易扩张得甚至比政府的地方实力更快：当地民众夺取谷物，以维护他们的官员再也不予尊重的那些主张（Bohstedt 1983, Charlesworth 1983, Tilly 1971）。还没有人对欧洲的夺粮事件做过足够广泛的地理学研究，以判定它们是否遵循了一种符合施坚雅理论的格局。然而，考虑到夺粮事件明显倾向于环绕大城市和港口发生，这样一种格局是颇为可信的。中国的匪盗、叛乱以及其他形式的集体冲突也表现出显著的地域差异，这些差异至少与帝国活动和商业活动的联合分布大致相应。由这一事实出发，我们不妨合理地在欧洲内部寻找类似的地理不平等。民众的集体行动很可能展现出一种施坚雅式的逻辑。
Eighteenth- and nineteenth-century Europe, for its part, saw marketing of food expand even faster than the local strength of governments: its local people seized grain to enforce claims that
their

officials would no longer respect (Bohstedt 1983, Charlesworth 1983, Tilly 1971). No one has done a sufficiently broad geography of grain seizures in Europe to determine whether they followed an appropriately Skinnerian pattern. Given the marked tendency of grain seizures to ring major cities and ports, however, such a pattern is quite plausible. China's banditry, rebellion, and other forms of collective conflict also showed marked regional differences that bear at least a rough correspondence to the joint distribution of imperial and mercantile activity. From that fact, we might reasonably search for similar geographic inequalities within Europe. Popular collective action might well display a Skinnerian logic.

施坚雅所描述的政治共变格局在欧洲也有对应物：在商业稀少地区，行政首府由一位总督通过直接的军事控制掌握权力，却几乎不能为国王产出什么收入；而级别较低的皇家官员被兴旺的地主和商人所环绕，除了与他们谈判别无选择。试看东普鲁士与西普鲁士的对比：在东普鲁士，国家的行政机关压倒了商人，偏向大地主；而在西普鲁士，类似的机关几乎消融在该地区的商业活动之中。加布里埃尔·阿尔当（Gabriel Ardant）三十年前就指出，财政体系与地区经济之间的“契合”程度决定了征税尝试的成本与效力（Ardant 1965）。在一个市场活动很少的地区，按估定价值以现金征收的土地税很可能征收成本极高、极不公平地落在民众身上、漏掉大量潜在收入，并激起广泛的抵抗。相反，在一个高度商业化的地区，一种统一的人头税所产生的收入比按资本所在和商业路径设计的可比税种更少，成本却更高。

The patterns of political covariation Skinner describes also have European counterparts: the administrative capitals in regions of scanty commerce in which a viceroy held power through direct military control but could produce little revenue for the king, the lower-ranking royal officials surrounded by prosperous landlords and merchants with whom they had no choice but to negotiate. Consider the contrast between eastern Prussia, where the state's administrative apparatus overwhelmed merchants in favor of great landlords, and western Prussia, where a similar apparatus almost dissolved in the region's commercial activity. Gabriel Ardant pointed out thirty years ago that the "fit" between fiscal system and regional economy determines the cost and effectiveness of attempts to tax (Ardant 1965). In an area with little market activity, a land tax based on estimated value and levied in cash is likely to cost a great deal to collect, strike the population very inequitably, miss a good deal of potential revenue, and incite widespread resistance. In a highly commercialized area, in contrast, a flat head tax generates less revenue at higher cost than a comparable tax designed to fit the loci of capital and the paths of commerce.

另一方面（阿尔当并未注意到这一点），在商业活动水平高的地方，商人往往握有相当大的政治权力，因而有能力阻止建立一个会夺取其资产、束缚其交易的国家。在欧洲，正如我们已经看到的，商业活动的规模强烈影响了用以建设国家实力的各种策略的可行性。除了随波罗的海贸易加快而繁荣起来的格但斯克之外，波兰商人未能打破大地主的控制。（颇具讽刺意味的是，波兰地主的权力也束缚了波兰的选举君主，从而使他成为普鲁士各城市眼中一个有吸引力的宗主——这些城市正试图摆脱条顿骑士团更为苛求的监护。）但阿姆斯特丹、杜布罗夫尼克、威尼斯和热那亚这些处在商业等级体系高点的城市的商人，能够规定任何国家在其领土上运作的条件。因此，施坚雅关于中国的模型有助于阐明欧洲国家形成的地理学。

On the other hand (as Ardant did not observe), with high levels of commercial activity, merchants often hold considerable political power, and therefore are in a position to prevent the creation of a state that will seize their assets and cramp their transactions. In Europe, as we have seen, the extent of commercial activity strongly affected the viability of the various tactics used to build state strength. Outside of Gdansk, which prospered with the quickening of Baltic trade, Polish merchants were unable to break the grip of great landlords. (Ironically, the power of Polish landlords also cramped Poland's elected king, and thereby made him an attractive suzerain for Prussian cities that were trying to escape the more demanding tutelage of the Teutonic Knights.) But the merchants of Amsterdam, Dubrovnik, Venice, and Genoa, high points in the commercial hierarchy, could dictate the terms on which any state would operate in their territories. Thus Skinner's model of China sheds light on the geography of state formation in Europe.

In fact, earlier chapters have laid out a model of Europe a Skinnerian can easily recognize. It has three elements:
一套以交换和资本积累为特征的社会关系，在其中，集中产生城市，不平等以剥削为基础；
另一套以强制为特征的社会关系，在其中，集中产生国家，不平等以支配为基础；
一套由国家从事的活动，这些活动使其代理人从他人那里获取资源。
a set of social relations characterized by exchange and capital accumulation in which concentration produces cities and inequality rests on exploitation;
another set of social relations characterized by coercion in which concentration produces states and inequality rests on domination;
a set of activities carried on by states which involve their agents in acquiring resources from others.
这两套社会关系所界定的网络以不均衡的方式相互接合：在一些地点，密集的强制与同等密集的资本相遇；在另一些地点，密集的强制遇到的却是稀薄的资本；如此等等。因此，在不同地点进行的类似国家活动运作方式不同，并产生不同的组织后果。这极为抽象地概括了本书至此的全部主旨。

The networks defined by the two sets of social relations articulate unevenly: at some locations dense concentrations of coercion meet equally dense concentrations of capital, at others dense coercion encounters sparse capital, and so on. Similar state activities carried on at different locations therefore work differently, and have different organizational consequences. That sums up, very abstractly, the main message of this whole book so far.
回想一下何为国家：一个分立的组织，控制着明确界定的领土内主要的集中强制手段，并在某些方面对同一领土内运作的所有其他组织行使优先权。（那么，民族国家

就是把所涉及的领土扩展到多个相邻地区，并保持一种相对集中、分化和自主的自身结构的国家。）武装的人们通过以下方式形成国家：在既定领土内积累并集中强制手段；创建一个至少部分区别于该领土内支配生产与再生产的那些组织的组织；夺取、收编或清除同一领土内其他集中的强制；界定边界；并在这些边界之内行使管辖权。他们通过把同样的过程扩展到相邻的新领土，并在推进过程中精心构建一个集中、分化和自主的组织，来创建民族国家。
国家组织的形成与转型，很大程度上是征服并维持对该领土内人民和财产之控制的种种努力的后果。尽管国家制造者心中总是怀着征服与控制的模型，并且常常自觉地遵循它们，但他们很少事先规划好这些活动所带来的国家的一步步建构。然而，他们的活动不可避免地造成了自上而下的强制控制等级体系。

Recall what a state is: a distinct organization that controls the principal concentrated means of coercion within a well-defined territory, and in some respects exercises priority over all other organizations operating within the same territory. (A
national

state, then, extends the territory in question to multiple contiguous regions, and maintains a relatively centralized, differentiated, and autonomous structure of its own.) Armed men form states by accumulating and concentrating their means of coercion within a given territory, by creating an organization that is at least partially distinct from those that govern production and reproduction in the territory, by seizing, co-opting, or liquidating other concentrations of coercion within the same territory, by defining boundaries, and by exercising jurisdiction within those boundaries. They create national states by extending the same processes to new adjacent territories and by elaborating a centralized, differentiated, and autonomous organization as they go.

The formation and transformation of state organization occur largely as consequences of efforts to conquer, and to maintain control over the people and property in the territory. Although statemakers always have models of conquest and control in mind, and frequently follow them self-consciously, they rarely plan out the step-by-step construction of the state that these activities bring into being. Nevertheless, their activity inevitably creates top-down hierarchies of coercive control.

当统治者形成并改造国家时，他们及其代理人消耗大量资源，尤其是那些适合军事用途的资源：人、武器、运输工具、食物。这些资源大部分已经嵌入其他组织和社会关系之中：家户、庄园、教会、村庄、封建义务、邻里之间的联系。统治者的问题在于从这些组织和社会关系中抽取必不可少的资源，同时确保今后有人会再生产并交出类似的资源。有两个因素塑造了国家获取资源的过程，并强烈影响该过程所产生的组织：自下而上的资本等级体系的性质，以及国家代理人试图从中抽取资源的任何地点在该等级体系中的位置。

As rulers form and transform states, they and their agents consume large quantities of resources, especially resources that lend themselves to military applications: men, arms, transport, food. Those resources are, for the most part, already embedded in other organizations and social relations: households, manors, churches, villages, feudal obligations, connections among neighbors. The ruler's problem is to extract the essential resources from those organizations and social relations, while ensuring that someone will reproduce and yield similar resources in the future. Two factors shape the process by which states acquire resources, and strongly affect the organization that results from the process: the character of the bottom-up hierarchy of capital, and the place within that hierarchy of any location from which a state's agents try to extract resources.

在欧洲，一个想要建国的人所面对的城市类型极为多样。借助又一个二维图（图5.1），我们可以按城市活动与其腹地活动的接合程度（从表面联系到深层联系）以及市场地位（从纯粹的地方性或区域性市场到国际贸易、加工和资本积累的中心）来排列城市。因此，13世纪的佛罗伦萨——其商人和食利者对其城郊领地（contado）的土地、生产和贸易行使广泛的控制——比热那亚更有资格算作一个大都会，因为热那亚是一个与其自身腹地联系较弱的国际纽带。15世纪的马德里颇为封闭于自身及其所在的卡斯蒂利亚部分，看起来更像一个区域性市场；而里斯本的支配地位则兼及葡萄牙内外。

The range of cities a would-be statemaker faced in Europe was very large. Resorting to yet another two-dimensional diagram (figure 5.1), we might array cities by the extent to which their activities articulated with those of their hinterlands (from a superficial to a profound connection) and by their market position (from a purely local or regional market to an international center of trade, processing, and capital accumulation). Thus thirteenth-century Florence, whose merchants and rentiers exercised extensive control over land, production, and trade in its
contado,

qualified as more of a metropolis than Genoa, an international link having weaker ties to its own hinterland. Fifteenth-century Madrid, rather closed in upon itself and its section of Castile, looked more like a regional market than Lisbon, whose dominance extended both inside and outside of Portugal.

这些区分之所以重要，是因为它们显著影响了不同类型国家的形成前景。一座城市的市场地位越高，任何积聚集中武力的人就越有可能不得不与设在那里的资本家谈判，甚至本人就是他们中的一员。一座城市与其腹地的经济接合越深，一个独立的地主群体在国家形成的任何过程中充当该城市的抗衡力量或敌人的可能性就越小。在欧洲国家形成的早期阶段，一座支配自身腹地并占据国际市场地位的城市，有很大的概率构成自己的自主国家，无论是像米兰那样的城邦，还是像威尼斯那样的城市帝国。

The distinctions matter because they significantly affected the prospects for the formation of different kinds of states. The higher a city's market position, the more likely that anyone building up concentrated force had to negotiate with the capitalists based there, or even be one of them. The greater its economic articulation with its hinterland, the less likely that a separate group of landlords would serve as the city's counterweight or enemy in any process of state formation. In the early stages of European state formation, a city that dominated its own hinterland and occupied an international market position had a strong probability of constituting its own autonomous state, whether a city-state like Milan or a city-empire like Venice.

在大约1800年以前盛行于欧洲的条件下，在城市大量繁衍的地区，国际贸易十分密集。其中一些城市占据了国际市场的中心地位，资本得以积累和集中。在那种情况下，任何人都无法在未经与当地资本家密切合作的情况下创建或改变国家。佛兰德、莱茵地区和波河流域对这一原理作了戏剧性的说明。在城市稀少的地区，条件则不同：在那里，国际贸易在经济生活中只起很小的作用，占据国际市场高位的城市寥寥无几（即使有的话），资本既不快速积累也不快速集中。在这样的地区，国家的形成通常既没有当地资本家的合作，也没有他们有效的反对。在那里，强制当道。波兰和匈牙利便是范例。介于二者之间，在一个除此之外由地主支配的地区里，只要存在至少一个主要的资本积累中心，就有可能走上一条通往国家的中间道路；在这条道路上，资本的持有者与强制的持有者相互斗争，但最终讨价还价出一种权宜共存之道（modus vivendi）。阿拉贡和英格兰即为适例。

Under the conditions prevailing in Europe before 1800 or so, in regions where cities proliferated, international trade was intense. Some of the cities occupied central positions in international markets, and capital accumulated and concentrated. In those circumstances, no one created or altered a state except in close collaboration with the local capitalists. Flanders, the Rhineland, and the Po Valley illustrate the principle dramatically. Conditions differed where cities were sparse; there, international trade played a small part in economic life, few cities (if any) occupied high positions in international markets, and capital neither accumulated nor concentrated at a rapid rate. In such regions, states commonly formed without either the collaboration or the effective opposition of local capitalists. There, coercion reigned. Poland and Hungary stand as exemplars. In between, the presence of at least one major center of capital accumulation in a region otherwise dominated by landlords made possible an intermediate path to the state, a path in which holders of capital and of coercion struggled, but ultimately bargained out a
modus vivendi.
Aragon and England provide cases in point.

这些差异在欧洲遵循一种界限分明的地理格局。虽然沿海地区集中了不成比例之多的城市，但地中海以外的港口一般腹地浅薄，背后是受地主控制的更大区域。一条大致从意大利半岛向西北延伸到英格兰南部的宽阔城市带，主导着主权碎裂的地图，也就是国家形成中资本家力量强大的区域；随着大西洋沿岸、北海和波罗的海的商业日益重要，这条城市带起着一种咖啡渗滤壶的作用，把商品、资本和城市人口从地中海以及它所连接的各个东方泵送上来。庞大而有力的民族国家主要形成于这条城市带的边缘，在那里，城市及其资本既易于接近，又不至于压倒一切。在更远的地方，国家占据着更大的领土，但直到相当晚近的时期，它们对领土内的人民和活动只行使间歇性的控制。

These differences followed a well-defined geographic pattern in Europe. Although seacoast regions had more than their share of cities, ports outside of the Mediterranean generally had shallow hinterlands, and backed on larger regions controlled by landlords. The broad urban column that reached roughly northwest from the Italian peninsula to southern England dominated the map of fragmented sovereignty, the zone of capitalist strength in state formation; as commerce on the Atlantic coast, the North Sea, and the Baltic gained importance, the column acted as a kind of percolator, pumping merchandise, capital, and urban population up from the Mediterranean and the various Easts to which it connected. Big, powerful national states formed chiefly at the edges of the urban column, where cities and their capital were accessible but not overwhelming. Farther out, states occupied even larger territories, but until fairly late exercised only episodic control over the people and activities within them.

这些相互对照的情境标示出国家变化的不同路径。为使讨论可行，让我们再次加以图式化（见图5.2），把众多路径简化为三条。该图主张：当人们开始在欧洲各地集中强制时，集中的资本之相对有无预示了（并在某种程度上造成了）国家结构变化的不同轨迹；尽管欧洲所有地区最终都向大型民族国家趋同，各国在很长一段时期内实际上是分道而行的；几个世纪里，强制型国家、资本型国家和资本化强制型国家在结构与行动上彼此越走越远。尽管粗糙，该图仍允许作出一些有用的区分。例如，在北欧诸国内部，我们可以如图5.3那样勾画出不同的路径。当然，为了认真对待这一图式，我们必须承认：芬兰、瑞典、挪威和丹麦在不同时期都曾从属于由他国支配的帝国和联邦；由这些名称所指的国家和属地的边界因征服与谈判而显著变动；17世纪中叶以前，丹麦实行的是强大的地主贵族与一位地主国王之间的经典联盟；而在公元900年以来的整个时期，芬兰独立于邻国而存在的岁月只有几十年。有了这些限定，该图便提供了一个机会，来勾画丹麦如何以相对未商业化的征服强权的身份开始这个千年，随后利用西欧与波罗的海之间不断增长的贸易而变得远比其邻国富庶，而芬兰则长久得多地保持着商业上的闭塞状态并受武力治理。

These contrasting circumstances marked out different paths of change in states. To make discussion feasible, let us again schematize (see figure 5.2), reducing many paths to just three. The diagram argues that when men began to concentrate coercion in various parts of Europe the relative presence or absence of concentrated capital predicted (and to some degree caused) different trajectories of change in state structure; although all regions of Europe eventually converged toward the large national state, states actually diverged over a long period; for several centuries, coercive, capitalist, and capitalized-coercion states moved further apart in structure and action. For all its crudity, the diagram allows some useful distinctions. Within the Nordic countries, for example, we might sketch the alternative paths as in figure 5.3. In order to take the scheme seriously, to be sure, we would have to recognize that at various times Finland, Sweden, Norway, and Denmark all belonged to empires and federations dominated by others, that the boundaries of the states and dependencies designated by those names fluctuated significantly as a result of conquest and negotiation, that before the middle of the seventeenth century Denmark operated a classic coalition between powerful landlord nobles and a landlord king, and that over the entire time since AD 900 Finland has enjoyed only a few decades of existence independent of neighboring powers. With those qualifications, the diagram provides an opportunity to sketch how Denmark began the millennium as a relatively uncommercialized conquering power, then capitalized on growing trade between western Europe and the Baltic to become significantly more prosperous than its neighbors, while Finland remained a commercial backwater, governed by force, much longer.

children: 北欧诸国创造了自己的一套强制型国家形成的变体。在17世纪以前，它们是欧洲乡村化最深的地区之一。许多城镇是作为王权的设防前哨而非重要的商业中心产生的。尽管卑尔根、哥本哈根等商业中心作为贸易前哨早已重要，但在1500年，该地区还没有一座城市拥有多达10,000名居民（de Vries 1984: 270）。德国商人长期支配斯堪的纳维亚贸易，以至于市议会和城市地理本身都常常分裂为德国人与本地人两个截然有别的部分。

The Nordic countries created their own variant of coercive state formation. Before the seventeenth century, they comprised one of Europe's most profoundly rural regions. Many towns came into being as fortified outposts of royal power rather than as significant commercial centers. Despite the early importance of Bergen, Copenhagen, and other commercial centers as outposts for trade, in 1500 no city in the region had as many as 10,000 inhabitants (de Vries 1984: 270). German merchants long dominated Scandinavian trade, to the extent that city councils and urban geography alike often split into distinct German and local sections.

斯堪的纳维亚的贸易几乎成为汉萨的垄断。汉萨诸城坚决排斥意大利银行家，并拒绝建立自己的银行和信贷机构。相反，它们依赖双边平衡的贸易，而且常常是以货易货（Kindleberger 1984: 44）。只是随着16世纪波罗的海贸易的加快，挪威、瑞典、芬兰或丹麦才开始出现可观的资本集中和城市人口集中。即便在那时，接替德国人的荷兰商人仍然经营着大部分贸易、资本和航运。然而，该地区的武士们在欧洲许多地方留下了印记。

Scandinavian trade became a near-monopoly of the Hanse. The Hanse cities resolutely excluded Italian bankers and refused to create banks and credit institutions of their own. Instead they relied on bilaterally balanced trade, often in kind (Kindleberger 1984: 44). Only with the quickening of Baltic trade during the sixteenth century did significant concentrations of capital and urban population start to appear in Norway, Sweden, Finland, or Denmark. Even then, the Dutch merchants who succeeded the Germans managed much of the trade, capital, and shipping. Yet the region's warriors left their mark on many parts of Europe.

在公元900年前后几个世纪里，维京人及其亲族在北方之外广泛征服，并常常建立起由武士兼地主支配的国家。然而，他们通常无法在自己的故乡走同样的道路。在那里，林业和渔业的突出地位、定居的稀疏、边疆的开放，以及外来入侵的罕见，共同保证了小土地持有者的存续，并限制了武士成为大地主的能力。为了获得兵役，瑞典国王所作的授予实际上反而增加了小土地所有者的人数。直到17世纪，他们都通过同一制度的各种变体来征集大部分兵员：贵族（后来还有富裕农民）只要为王室提供装备齐全、报酬微薄的骑兵，即可获得免税资格；而平民则分担提供步兵的责任，还要向步兵及其家庭提供土地。除了驻扎在战区和边疆省份的雇佣兵之外，这套安排无需王室支出大笔现金便能自行维持。

In the centuries around AD 900 Vikings and their cousins conquered widely outside of the North, and often set up states dominated by warrior-landlords. They were generally unable, however, to follow the same course in their homelands. There the salience of forestry and fishing, the thinness of settlement, the openness of frontiers, and the rarity of external invasions combined to assure the survival of smallholders and to set limits on the ability of warriors to become great landlords. In seeking to secure military service, Swedish kings made grants that actually multiplied small landowners. Up to the seventeenth century, they drew most of their troops by means of variants of the same system: nobles (and later rich peasants) qualified for tax exemption by fitting out cavalrymen for poorly-paid royal service, while commoners shared the responsibility for supplying infantrymen as well as providing land to them and their families. Except for mercenaries stationed in war zones and frontier provinces, the arrangements sustained themselves without large cash outlays by the crown.

瑞典和丹麦维持庞大的军事力量达数个世纪之久。在古斯塔夫·瓦萨（1521—60）及其继任者治下，瑞典建立起令人生畏的军事力量，代价是使经济的大部分屈从于国家的要求。由丹麦、瑞典和挪威组成的斯堪的纳维亚联盟（1397—1523）的形成，在很大程度上是为了对抗德国商人和汉萨同盟的商业支配而伸张王权。在其他举措之外，瓦萨剥夺了教士的财产，创建了一个隶属于国家的新教教会。与他同时代的俄国人一样，古斯塔夫·瓦萨还提倡这样一种观点：“一切土地都属于王室，非贵族只是在暂时占有土地，他们只有履行了对政府的财政义务，才能指望继续保有土地”（Shennan 1974: 63）。在一个大体上自给自足的经济中，国家为支付战争费用而寻求现金，这促成了采矿和制造业的扩张、财政机构的精细化、一笔可观国债的开端、对旧有代议机构的绕过，以及教士（此时属于本国的新教教会）越来越多地参与为王室记账（Lindegren 1985, Nilsson 1988）。

Sweden and Denmark maintained major military forces for several centuries. Under Gustav Vasa (1521-60) and his successors, Sweden built up formidable military power at the cost of subjecting large parts of the economy to demands of the state. The Scandinavian Union of Denmark, Sweden, and Norway (1397-1523) formed largely as a means of asserting royal power against the commercial dominance of German merchants and the Hanseatic League. Among other moves, Vasa dispossessed the clergy and created a Protestant church subordinated to the state. Like his Russian contemporaries, Gustav Vasa also forwarded the view "that all land belonged to the crown and those non-nobles enjoying temporary possession of it could only expect continued tenure while they fulfilled their fiscal obligations to the government" (Shennan 1974: 63). The state's search for cash to pay for war in a largely subsistence economy motivated an expansion of mining and manufacturing, an elaboration of the fiscal apparatus, the beginning of a substantial national debt, a bypassing of older representative assemblies, and an increasing involvement of the clergy (now Protestant and national) in record-keeping for the crown (Lindegren 1985, Nilsson 1988).

商业气息更浓的丹麦一直到三十年战争为止，都以王室领地的收入来支付其战争费用。事实上，在1660年以前，丹麦的平民不能拥有土地。1640年代瑞典与丹麦之间的战争加上经济萧条，促发了丹麦贵族与选举君主之间围绕收入的斗争。在一场政变中，王室建立了世袭君主制，大大削弱了贵族的权力。但这意味着贵族的合作减少。结果，丹麦决定性地转向征税，包括利润丰厚的厄勒海峡通行税。“1608年丹麦国家收入的67%来自王室领地，半个世纪之后，这类收入只占10%”（Rystad 1983: 15）。确实，为了清偿战争造成的债务，君主国在1660年至1675年间卖掉了大部分土地（Ladewig Petersen 1983: 47）。因此，17世纪战争制造的费用在丹麦和瑞典都引起了重大的政府变革。

More commercial Denmark financed its warmaking from the income of crown lands up through the Thirty Years' War. Indeed, until 1660 no commoner could own land in Denmark. The war between Sweden and Denmark in the 1640s combined with economic depression to precipitate a struggle over revenues between the Danish aristocracy and the elected king. In a coup d'état, the crown established a hereditary monarchy and greatly reduced noble power. But that meant reduced cooperation from the nobility. As a result Denmark made a decisive shift to taxation, including the lucrative tolls of the Sound. "Whereas 67 % of Danish state revenues in 1608 consisted of income from crown lands, a half century later such revenues amounted to only 10%" (Rystad 1983: 15). To liquidate its war-induced debts, indeed, the monarchy sold off the bulk of its lands between 1660 and 1675 (Ladewig Petersen 1983: 47). Thus the expense of seventeenth-century warmaking produced major governmental changes in both Denmark and Sweden.

瑞典（与丹麦一样）在三十年战争期间主要依靠雇佣兵，但随着17世纪后期兵员需求上升，又转回征召本国军队。查理十一世（1672—97）策动了自己的一场政变：从大贵族手中夺回其前任为支付战争费用而出卖的王室领地，然后把其中大部分土地分配给兼职士兵，这些士兵因而须以服兵役来换取生计。到1708年，瑞典和芬兰（当时是瑞典的一个省）从约两百万总人口中出动了111,000名士兵（Roberts 1979: 45）。瑞典君主国经常资金短缺，却能通过出口铜和铁、在丰富的矿产基础上建立自己的大型军火工业，以及从所征服的领土上索取巨额款项，来支付战争费用而不致破产。只要征服继续，这套贡赋制度就运转得足够好，但随着和平与稳定统治的到来，它就崩溃了。

Sweden (like Denmark) relied largely on mercenaries during the Thirty Years' War, but shifted back toward a conscripted national force as its troop requirements rose during the later seventeenth century. Charles XI (1672-97) engineered his own coup d'état by wresting from magnates crown lands his predecessors had been selling off to pay for their warmaking, and then allocating much of the land to part-time soldiers who thus owed military service for their means of subsistence. By 1708 Sweden and Finland (then a Swedish province) were fielding 111,000 troops from a total population of about two million (Roberts 1979: 45). The Swedish monarchy was constantly short of funds, but was able to pay for war without bankruptcy by exporting copper and iron, by building its own large arms industry on its rich base of minerals, and by exacting enormous payments from the territories it won. That system of tribute worked well enough so long as conquest continued, but collapsed at the advent of peace and stable rule.

随着查理十二世遇刺（1718），瑞典放弃了谋求帝国权力的努力。然而到那时，在人口稀少、经济相对非货币化、资产阶级微不足道的基础上创建一支庞大军队，已经产生了一个非常可观的国家机器，其中的文职官僚和教士为王室做了大量工作。挪威（直到1905年一直处于丹麦、随后是瑞典的统治之下）和芬兰（直到1809年是瑞典的一个省，此后直到1917年是俄国的大公国）尽管处于依附地位，相对于欧洲市场也更为边缘，却经历了类似的演变。丹麦则掌握着厄勒海峡的航运，并从该航运中获得可观的通行税；它在全部军事投入中用于海军的比重远高于邻国；并在与南方德国人的贸易中建设商业化的农业——由此产生了一个较大的资产阶级和一个较小的国家机器。

With the assassination of Charles XII (1718), Sweden abandoned its drive for imperial power. By that time, however, the creation of a large military force on the basis of a small population, a relatively unmonetized economy, and an exiguous bourgeoisie had produced a very substantial state apparatus in which civil bureaucrats and clergy did a great deal of work for the crown. Norway (which lived under Danish, and then Swedish, rule until 1905) and Finland (which was a province of Sweden until 1809 and then a Russian grand duchy until 1917) underwent similar evolutions despite their dependent positions and greater peripherality with respect to European markets. Denmark, commanding the traffic of the Sound with the substantial tolls that traffic generated, putting a much larger part of its military effort into the navy than its neighbors, and building commercialized agriculture in trade with Germans to the south, created a larger bourgeoisie and a smaller state apparatus.
尽管随着1750年以后土地持有的整合，瑞典无地劳工的数量大幅增加（Winberg 1978），但他们从未落入大土地持有者的控制之下。相反，国家官僚机构把监督直接延伸到农民和劳工身上，而这些人仍保有相当的讨价还价能力；在瑞典，农民确实以独立于教士、贵族和资产者之外的一个等级，保有自己的代表权。由此形成的国家以强制为组织轴心，几乎不给资本留出空间，但也没有南方邻国那样的大领地领主。

Although Swedish landless laborers increased greatly in number with the consolidation of holdings after 1750 (Winberg 1978), they never fell under the control of big landholders. Instead, the state bureaucracy extended its monitoring directly to peasants and laborers, who retained considerable bargaining power; in Sweden, indeed, peasants maintained representation through a separate Estate from those of the clergy, nobility, and bourgeoisie. The resulting states organized around coercion and gave little scope to capital, but lacked the great territorial lords of their neighbors to the south.

因此，与欧洲其他地区相比，北欧各地区都聚集在通往国家地位的强制密集型道路之上。在另一个极端，意大利的商业城邦和城市帝国走上了一条明显不同的国家之路：它们依靠高度的资本集中，但对强制的集中不如其北欧表亲那样彻底，也更短暂。这就是要点所在：欧洲国家的变化轨迹差异极大，并产生了彼此对照的国家类型。那些走上资本化强制道路的国家最终在欧洲占据支配地位，其他国家则向它们的特征趋同。但在欧洲国家体系的这一晚近整合之前，许多其他类型的国家形成起来，并且运作得相当有效。

In comparison with the rest of Europe, then, the Nordic areas all clustered along the coercion-intensive path to statehood. At the other extreme, the commercial city-states and city-empires of Italy followed a distinctly different path to the state, relying on high concentrations of capital, but concentrating coercion less decisively and more temporarily than their North European cousins. That is the main point: trajectories of change in European states differed dramatically, and produced contrasting kinds of state. Those that followed the capitalized-coercion path eventually became dominant in Europe, and other states converged on their characteristics. But before that late consolidation of the European state system, many other kinds of state formed and performed quite effectively.

让我重述关键之点。欧洲各地的统治者彼此互动，并共同卷入国际战争，从事着相似的活动：他们力图创造并利用战争制造能力以谋取自身优势。但每一个人都是在由他本人领土上盛行的强制与资本的组合所设定的高度可变条件下这样做的。不同的组合意味着不同的阶级格局、不同的潜在盟友和敌人、国家活动留下的不同组织残留、对国家活动的不同抵抗形式、抽取资源的不同策略，因而也意味着资源抽取效率的不同水平。由于每一次互动都产生新的组织残留和社会关系，一个国家到某个时点为止所走的道路，限制了其统治者在那个时点之后可以选择的各种策略。正因如此，即便是处于相同强制与资本位置的国家，在不同时点上的行为也略有不同。尽管如此，最大的区别还是把强制密集型、资本密集型和资本化强制型这三种国家形成轨迹区分开来。

Let me recall the crucial points. Interacting with each other and jointly involved in international wars, rulers in different parts of Europe pursued similar activities: they sought to create and use warmaking capacity to their own advantages. But each one did so under the highly variable conditions set by the combination of coercion and capital that prevailed in his own territory. Alternative combinations meant different class configurations, different potential allies and enemies, different organizational residues of state activity, different forms of resistance to state activity, different strategies for the extraction of resources, and therefore different levels of efficiency in resource extraction. Because each interaction produced new organizational residues and social relations, the path followed by a state up to a certain point in time limited the strategies open to its rulers beyond that point. For that reason, even states occupying identical locations with respect to coercion and capital at different points in time behaved somewhat differently. Nevertheless, the great distinctions separated coercion-intensive, capital-intensive, and capitalized-coercion trajectories of state formation.

且看那条经由高度强制而延伸的道路。在如今苏联的欧洲部分，贸易路线稀疏，资本匮乏。公元990年，商业和制造业的主要中心是基辅，它是连接拜占庭与印度、中国及文明世界其余部分的巨大商业带的北方分支；基辅还位于连接波罗的海与拜占庭的次要南北贸易路线之上。相传在988年，基辅的弗拉基米尔大公接受了拜占庭分支的基督教洗礼，从而巩固了与拜占庭的联系。基辅诸公是南来征服的维京人的后裔，对俄罗斯其他城邦和地区公国的统治者行使微弱的主权。在地方层面，大部分土地仍处于农民公社的控制之下；与东欧其他地区一样，地主能够以贡赋、罚金、使用费和在其庄园上从事部分时间劳动的形式，从农民那里强制榨取收入，但很难干预家户和村社对自己地块的经营。定居的稀疏使耕作者比较容易逃离苛刻的主人，到其他领主的土地上去寻求庇护。大地主还屡遭草原游牧民族的袭击和征服。然而在更大的规模上，相对自主的武装地主支配着大部分领土。

Take the path that led through high coercion. In the European portion of what is now the USSR, trade routes were thin and capital lacking. In AD 990, the chief center of commerce and manufacturing was Kiev, which served as a northern offshoot of the great commercial band connecting Byzantium with India, China, and the rest of the civilized world; Kiev also lay on the lesser north-south trade route linking the Baltic to Byzantium. In the year 988, tradition says, Prince Vladimir of Kiev had cemented the Byzantine connection by accepting baptism into its branch of Christianity. Princes of Kiev, descendants of Vikings who had moved south to conquer, exercised weak sovereignty over the rulers of other Russian city-states and regional dukedoms. At a local level, much of the land remained under the control of peasant communes; as in the rest of eastern Europe, landlords were able to coerce income from peasants in the form of dues, fines, use fees, and part-time labor on their estates, but could only intervene with difficulty in households' and communities' management of their own plots. The thinness of settlement made it relatively easy for cultivators to flee oppressive masters and seek refuge in the lands of other lords. Great landlords also suffered repeated raids and conquests from the mobile peoples of the steppe. On a larger scale, nevertheless, relatively autonomous armed landlords dominated most of the territory.

在其西面，公元990年时一个波兰国家正通过征服名义上属于神圣罗马帝国的领土而扩张壮大。它也在向东扩张；1069年，其大公率军直抵基辅，把自己的一个亲属扶上了俄罗斯的王位。在西北方，维京人的国家不时试图把边疆扩展到俄罗斯和波兰所主张的土地上去。一个好战的保加利亚国家在俄罗斯的西南方向炫耀武力。在同一地区，波希米亚和匈牙利的国王们（后者刚刚加冕）同样在划定各自的控制区。在欧洲西部边缘——尤其是在不列颠群岛、伊比利亚半岛和意大利——不断从斯堪的纳维亚和中东涌出的武装入侵者通常夺取土地并建立以农业为基础的国家；无论多么稀疏，他们总归定居在土地上。相比之下，欧洲东部的几乎整整三分之一地区，正在形成为收取贡赋的国家，这些国家声称对大片领土拥有优先权，但即便有治理，也只是松散的治理。

To the west, in AD 990, a Polish state was aggrandizing by conquest of territories nominally belonging to the Holy Roman Empire. It was also expanding eastward; in 1069 its grand duke drove his armies to Kiev and put one of his kinsmen on the Russian throne. To the northwest, Viking states made periodic attempts to extend their frontiers into the lands claimed by Russia and Poland. A bellicose Bulgarian state flexed its muscles to Russia's southwest. In the same region, kings of Bohemia and Hungary (the latter newly crowned) were likewise marking out their own zones of control. Around Europe's western rim - notably in the British Isles, the Iberian peninsula, and Italy - the armed invaders that rolled continually out of Scandinavia and the Middle East commonly seized land and created states based on agriculture; however thinly, they settled on the land. Almost all of Europe's eastern third, in contrast, was forming into tribute-taking states that claimed priority in large territories but governed them only loosely, if at all.

在东方，游牧征服者同时既威胁任何有实力的国家的霸权，又与他们能够剥削的农业国家的继续存在有着密切的利害关系。当人数众多、力量过于强大，以致无法作为寄生者附着于现有国家之上时，他们中的一些人便逐渐定居下来，形成自己的剥削性国家。通过这一切方式，他们在公元500年之后的一千年里塑造了东欧的国家形成模式。他们一个接一个地呼啸着冲出草原：保加尔人、马扎尔人、佩切涅格人、蒙古人、突厥人，以及许多较小的族群。

In the East, nomadic conquerors simultaneously threatened the hegemony of any substantial state and maintained a strong investment in the continued existence of agrarian states they could exploit. When their numbers were large and their force too great for them to fix themselves as parasites on existing states, some of them gradually settled and formed their own exploitative states. In all these ways, they shaped the east European pattern of state formation for a thousand years after AD 500. One after another, they roared out of the steppe: Bulgars, Magyars, Petchenegs, Mongols, Turks, and many lesser peoples.

来自东南方的入侵延续到公元1000年之后很久，并在1230年代达到高峰，当时蒙古人洗劫了基辅，并在其领地内确立了霸权。在那时，蒙古人正在走向统治从俄罗斯到中国的欧亚大陆大部分地区。诚然，在其领地的许多地方，那种“统治”不过是要求正式臣服、索取贡赋、击退竞争的主张者，以及对不够合作的臣民偶尔进行军事袭击而已。然而，两个世纪里，俄罗斯诸公一直向金帐汗国缴纳贡赋、表示臣服，而后者把首都设在下伏尔加河。的确，金帐汗国的汗们常常强迫俄罗斯执政诸公的儿子居住在蒙古首都，从而使他们成为其父履行义务的人质（Dewey 1988: 254）。

Invasions from the southeast continued well past the Millennium, reaching their peak in the 1230s, when Mongols sacked Kiev and established hegemony in its domains. At that point, Mongols were on their way to ruling most of Eurasia, from Russia to China. In much of their domain, to be sure, that "rule" consisted of little more than the requirement of formal submission, the exaction of tribute, the fighting off of rival claimants, and the conduct of occasional military raids on insufficiently cooperative subjects. For two centuries, nevertheless, Russian princes paid tribute and homage to the Golden Horde, who set their capital on the lower Volga. Indeed, the Horde's khans commonly forced sons of ruling Russian princes to inhabit the Mongol capital, and thus to serve as hostages to their fathers' performances (Dewey 1988: 254).

自15世纪起，来自东南方的攻击的频率和强度似乎有所下降，因为蒙古中央帝国崩溃了，草原上的武装骑手把注意力转向其南翼那些脆弱而富庶得多的国家。1571年鞑靼人洗劫莫斯科时，他们不知不觉地标志了对俄罗斯重大入侵的终结。在17世纪，准噶尔蒙古人实际上曾与俄罗斯人合作征服西伯利亚。很可能，欧亚草原上毁灭性的疾病（尤其是鼠疫）与欧洲开辟海上航线（这些航线为从中国和印度到欧洲的古老商队道路提供了可行的替代）这两者的结合，削弱了草原对俄罗斯国家创建者的威胁（McNeill 1976: 195-6）。

From the fifteenth century onward the frequency and intensity of attacks from the southeast seems to have declined as the central Mongol empire collapsed and the steppe's armed horsemen turned their attention to the vulnerable, and much richer, states along their southern flank. When Tatars sacked Moscow in 1571, they unknowingly marked the end of major incursions into Russia. During the seventeenth century, Zunghar Mongols actually collaborated with the Russians in the conquest of Siberia. Very likely the combination of devastating disease (especially plague) on the Eurasian steppe and the European opening of sea routes that offered viable alternatives to the ancient caravan road from China and India to Europe diminished the threat from the steppe to creators of Russian states (McNeill 1976: 195-6).

到1400年，从维斯瓦河到乌拉尔的欧洲正在整合为若干大型国家，包括立陶宛、诺夫哥罗德共和国和金帐汗国的领地。在西北方，条顿骑士团的普鲁士和一个暂时包括瑞典与挪威的丹麦支配着波罗的海。在16世纪上半叶，立陶宛和莫斯科这两个辽阔的大公国，分割了那条从东方沿黑海北岸一直延伸到匈牙利、希腊和亚得里亚海的穆斯林王国带以北的地区。（1569年，立陶宛将与其西面的波兰合并，从而在俄罗斯与欧洲其余部分之间置入一个庞大——尽管治理松散——的国家。）16世纪开辟的从英格兰和荷兰到阿尔汉格尔斯克的北极海路，加强了日益壮大的俄罗斯国家与欧洲的联系。

By 1400, Europe from the Vistula to the Urals was consolidating into large states, including Lithuania, the republic of Novgorod, and the realm of the Golden Horde. To the northwest, the Prussia of the Teutonic Knights and a Denmark temporarily including Sweden and Norway dominated the Baltic. During the first half of the sixteenth century, the vast grand duchies of Lithuania and Moscow divided the area above the band of Muslim kingdoms that extended from the east along the north shore of the Black Sea all the way to Hungary, Greece, and the Adriatic. (In 1569, Lithuania would unite with Poland, to its west, placing a huge, if thinly-governed, state between Russia and the rest of Europe.) The sixteenth-century establishment of an Arctic sea route from England and Holland to Archangel fortified the European connections of the growing Russian state.

彼得大帝（1689—1725）和叶卡捷琳娜大帝（1762—96）的征服把俄罗斯的边界最终推进到黑海，并暂时推进到爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和卡累利阿。两位统治者都加强了俄罗斯对西欧文化与政治的参与。拿破仑战争结束时，欧洲俄罗斯大致处于其现今的边界之内，与普鲁士、波兰、匈牙利和奥斯曼帝国相邻。奥斯曼国家本身是来自东方的征服的产物，它覆盖巴尔干，并西向延伸到与亚得里亚海接壤的奥地利领土的狭长地带。在16世纪与18世纪之间，欧洲的整个东部边疆整合为若干声称控制大片土地的国家。与此同时，俄罗斯的国家和经济把取向从东南转向西北。与13、14世纪的收取贡赋的国家相比，这些国家对各自的边界行使了可观的控制，对其境内人口行使了相当大的权力。

Conquests of Peter the Great (1689-1725) and Catherine the Great (1762- 96) brought Russia's boundaries definitively to the Black Sea and provisionally to Estonia, Latvia, and Karelia. Both rulers intensified the involvement of Russia in the culture and politics of western Europe. The end of the Napoleonic Wars left European Russia within something like its present borders, adjacent to Prussia, Poland, Hungary, and the Ottoman Empire. The Ottoman state, itself an outgrowth of conquest from the east, covered the Balkans and reached west to touch the thin strip of Austrian territory bordering the Adriatic. Between the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries, Europe's entire eastern frontier consolidated into states that claimed control over large expanses of land. At the same time, the Russian state and economy shifted their orientations from southeast to northwest. As compared with the tribute-collecting states of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries these states exercised significant control over their borders and substantial power over the populations within them.

几个世纪里，波兰一直是那个证明规则的例外：在这个国家，名义上的统治者永远无法统治大地主，也很少能让他们参加持久而协调的军事努力。在1760年代，当波兰国家仍然占据着比法国更大的领土时，其国家军队只召集到16,000人，而波兰贵族却拥有约30,000名武装人员。与此同时，相邻的俄罗斯、奥地利和普鲁士却各以20万至50万的军队严阵以待（Ratajczyk 1987: 167）。随着大众军队的形成，如果既不能与你的大国邻邦匹敌，也不能与其中至少一个结盟，就会招致征服。在18世纪后期，俄罗斯、奥地利和普鲁士吞并了波兰相邻的部分，最终一点也没有留下。

Poland remained for centuries the exception that proved the rule, the country in which the nominal ruler could never rule the great landlords, and could rarely get them to join in a sustained, coordinated military effort. During the 1760s, when the Polish state still occupied a territory larger than that of France, the national army mustered only 16,000 men, while Polish nobles had some 30,000 men under arms. This at a time when adjacent Russia, Austria, and Prussia stood by with armies of 200 to 500 thousand men (Ratajczyk 1987: 167). As mass armies formed, failure to match your great neighbors, or to ally with at least one of them, invited conquest. In the later eighteenth century Russia, Austria, and Prussia swallowed adjacent sections of Poland, eventually leaving none behind.
波兰在19世纪再次沦为普鲁士、奥地利和俄罗斯的猎物，但除此之外，俄罗斯的欧洲边界直到第一次世界大战都保持相对稳定；一战的解决方案在新成立的苏联以西安置了一系列小共和国，外加一个颇具规模的波兰。第二次世界大战把其中一些共和国重新纳入苏联的国家领土，把其余的纳入其势力范围。因此，讨论“俄罗斯”国家的形成，就是追踪一系列巨大的霸权与领土变迁。

Poland again fell prey to Prussia, Austria, and Russia in the nineteenth century, but otherwise Russia's European borders remained relatively stable until World War I, whose settlement placed a series of small republics, plus a substantial Poland, to the west of the newly-formed Soviet Union. World War II brought some of those republics back into the USSR's state territory, and the rest of them into its orbit. To discuss the formation of the "Russian" state is thus to follow a titanic series of changes in hegemony and territory.

在20世纪以前，那片领土上没有任何地方拥有巨大的城市集中，也很少有地方伸入欧洲大陆贸易密集的区域。的确，1300年以后，随着从中国延伸到巴尔干的古老商业带（因而也包括它向北伸向波罗的海的延伸部分）的收缩，以及掠夺成性的蒙古人阻断了通往地中海和黑海的通路，包括基辅、斯摩棱斯克、莫斯科和诺夫哥罗德在内的曾经繁荣的城市网络变得稀疏了。16世纪贸易的复兴使城镇增多，但并未产生任何近似于西欧和地中海欧洲城市密度的东西。俄罗斯国家是在一个资本匮乏的环境中成形的。

Before the twentieth century, none of that territory contained a great concentration of cities, and little of it even reached into the continent's regions of intense trade. After 1300, indeed, with the contraction of the old commercial belt that ran from China to the Balkans (and therefore of its northward extension to the Baltic), and with predatory Mongols blocking access to the Mediterranean and the Black Sea, the once-thriving network of cities including Kiev, Smolensk, Moscow, and Novgorod thinned out. The sixteenth-century revival of trade multiplied towns, but did not bring into being anything resembling the urban density of western and Mediterranean Europe. The Russian state took shape in a capital-poor environment.

这个环境同时也是强制富集的。在公元990年之后的五个世纪里，在欧洲那一部分成长起来的各个国家都靠征服运作、靠贡赋为生，并且（“统治”一词在此是夸大）主要通过拥有自身权力基础的地方大贵族来治理。在蒙古霸权之下，北方那些大体独立的诸公把主权分赐给地主，这些地主在其辖区内把对农民的经济控制和政治控制融为一体。在16世纪，随着蒙古国家的崩溃，俄罗斯向南和向东的征服产生了一套制度：把土地和劳动力授予武士；强迫农民劳动；限制农民的迁徙权利；为战争而不断增加税收；俄罗斯农奴制的持久特征开始出现。

The environment was also coercion-rich. For five centuries after AD 990 the various states that grew up in that part of Europe operated through conquest, fed on tribute, and ruled (the word exaggerates) chiefly through regional magnates who had their own bases of power. Under Mongol hegemony, the largely independent princes of the North parceled out their sovereignty to landlords who fused economic and political control of the peasants in their jurisdictions. During the sixteenth century, as the Mongol states collapsed, Russian conquests to the south and east brought into being a system of land and labor grants to warriors, forced labor by peasants, restrictions on their right to move, and rising taxation for war; the durable traits of Russian serfdom began to appear.

到此为止，俄罗斯皇帝们一直试图以不足的武力统治一片广袤的领土。他们的统治相当间接，要通过一个握有巨大权力、并保有制约王室要求之能力的教会和一个贵族阶层。莫斯科沙皇伊凡三世（大帝，1462—1505）和伊凡四世（雷帝，1533—84）开始通过削弱独立地主的权力来建立更为直接的统治；他们以军队和官僚机构取而代之，而这两者通过王室授予其主要官员的帝国土地而依附于王室。杰罗姆·布卢姆（Jerome Blum）记述道，“伊凡［大帝］及其继任者”
一心要建立他们所需的军事力量，以征服其兄弟诸公、粉碎本国波雅尔的寡头野心、抵御外来入侵并扩张其疆域。他们需要一支尽可能依附于自己的军队，从而可以依靠其忠诚。但他们没有钱去购买所需的人手和效忠。于是他们决定使用土地。

Up to that point, Russian emperors were trying to rule a vast territory with insufficient force. They governed quite indirectly, through a church and a nobility that held tremendous powers and retained the ability to check royal demands. Muscovite tsars Ivan III (the Great, 1462-1505) and Ivan IV (the Terrible, 1533-84) began to establish more direct rule by sapping the power of independent landlords; in their place they created an army and a bureaucracy attached to the crown through the imperial land grants their chief officers enjoyed. "Ivan [the Great] and his successors," reports Jerome Blum,

were intent upon building up the military forces they needed to conquer their brother princes, to crush the oligarchic ambitions of their own boyars, to stave off foreign invasions, and to expand their realm. They needed an army that was as dependent as possible upon them, and upon whose loyalty, therefore, they could themselves depend. But they lacked the money to buy the men and the allegiance they required. So they decided to use land.

那是典型的强制密集型策略。由于大部分关键土地属于拥有武装、半独立的地主，沙皇的重组引发了与贵族的血腥战斗。沙皇们赢了。在这一过程中，得到帝国恩宠的地主相对于其反叛的邻人获得了显著优势：他们可以指望政府的武装力量，把原本可以随意流动的农民固定在他们的土地上。于是，在一个资本稀少的地区，战争制造和国家制造的逻辑促使统治者用没收来的土地购买官职持有者的效忠。最终，俄罗斯的统治者确立了一条原则：只有国家的仆从才能拥有土地；尽管例外和违犯比比皆是，这条原则却为官职的增殖、为官员与土地持有者在剥削农民方面的合作，提供了又一个激励。

That was the quintessential coercion-intensive strategy. Since most of the essential land belonged to armed, semi-independent landlords, the tsars' reorganization precipitated bloody battles with the nobility. The tsars won. In the process, landlords who enjoyed imperial favor gained a signal advantage over their rebellious neighbors: they could count on the government's armed force to fix an otherwise footloose peasantry on their lands. Thus the logic of warmaking and statemaking in a region of little capital led rulers to buy officeholders with expropriated land. Eventually Russia's rulers established the principle that only servants of the state could own land; although exceptions and violations abounded, the principle provided yet another incentive for the multiplication of offices, and for collaboration between officials and landholders in the exploitation of the peasantry.

把小块地产置于逐利的官职持有者手中，增加了西北部农民所受的压力。结合向南和向东开辟新领土，这种压力导致了古老定居农业区的人口减少，而这又只是增加了通过地方惯例和帝国敕令把农民固定在原地的动机；所谓1649年的《会议法典》把一套已经发展了两个世纪的农奴制度编纂成文。此外，奴隶劳动——尤其是在较新的定居地区——在16、17世纪继续扩大。在18世纪，为了从奴隶和农奴那里抽取收入，沙皇们实际上消除了二者之间的法律区别。在试图对单个农民征税的尝试失败之后，彼得大帝让地主负责人头税，这一举措加强了王室与地主的相互依赖，更不用说地主对不幸的农奴所行使的、有国家支持的权力了。彼得在1700年下令，任何获得自由的奴隶或农奴都必须立即报到服兵役，若不被接纳服役，则须把自己绑定于另一个主人。彼得同样创造了一个独特的贵族阶层，按为沙皇服务的等级整齐划分。俄罗斯获得了一种由国家所界定、支持和支配的社会等级体系，其程度是西欧难以想象的。

The placing of small estates in the hands of profit-seeking officeholders increased the pressure on peasants in the northwest. Combined with the opening of new territories to the south and east, that pressure induced a depopulation of the old areas of settled agriculture, which only increased the incentive to fix peasants in place by local practice and imperial decree; the so-called Assembly Code of 1649 codified a system of serfdom that had been developing for two centuries. In addition, slave labor, especially in the newer areas of settlement, continued to expand during the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. During the eighteenth century, in seeking to extract revenue from slaves as well as serfs, the tsars practically eliminated the legal distinction between them. After an abortive attempt to tax individual peasants, Peter the Great made landlords responsible for the soul tax, an act that reinforced the interdependence of crown and landlords, not to mention the state-backed power that landlords wielded over their hapless serfs. Peter decreed in 1700 that any freed slave or serf must report immediately for military service, and if rejected for service bind himself to another master. Peter likewise created a distinctive nobility, neatly graded by rank of service to the tsar. To a degree unimaginable in western Europe, Russia acquired a social hierarchy defined, supported, and dominated by the state.

从上到下，新兴的社会关系结构都依赖强制。当俄罗斯国家开始认真与其全副武装的西方邻国交战时，从一个非商业化的经济中抽取关键收入的努力，使国家结构成倍扩张。与此同时，对位于莫斯科公国与奥斯曼帝国之间的土地的征服扩大了军事机器，输出了俄罗斯的农奴制和土地持有模式，并把帝国官僚机构建设到其充分而笨重的形态。彼得大帝开始了消除分离主义的巨大努力，要使帝国的所有部分——及其收入——都服从莫斯科的规章和中央行政：

From top to bottom, the emerging structure of social relations depended on coercion. As the Russian state began seriously to engage in war with its heavily armed western neighbors, the effort to extract essential revenues from an uncommercialized economy multiplied the state structure. At the same time, the conquest of lands lying between Muscovy and the Ottoman Empire expanded the military apparatus, exported the Russian mode of serfdom and landholding, and built up the imperial bureaucracy to its full, ponderous form. Peter the Great began the great effort to eliminate separatisms, to subject all segments of the empire - and their revenues - to Muscovite regulations and central administration:
伴随彼得根除乌克兰分离主义的运动而来的，是一项从盖特曼政权（Hetmanate）中最大限度地抽取经济和人力资源的政策。关于贸易路线、国家垄断、外国货物关税以及进出口税的规章首次被引入……彼得还开始大规模征召哥萨克，不是为了战争，而是为了帝国的公共工程——修建运河、防御工事，尤其是彼得最钟爱的工程：新首都圣彼得堡。（Kohut 1988: 71；另见 Raeff 1983）

Accompanying Peter's campaign to weed out Ukrainian separatism was a policy of extracting the maximum in economic and human resources from the Hetmanate. Regulations on trade routes, state monopolies, tariffs on foreign goods, and import-export taxes were introduced for the first time . . . Peter also began a massive conscription of Cossacks, not for war but for imperial public works - the building of canals, fortifications, and, especially, Peter's favorite project, the new capital of St. Petersburg. (Kohut 1988: 71; see also Raeff 1983)
叶卡捷琳娜大帝通过彻底废除半自治的盖特曼政权，完成了对乌克兰的并入。同一套官僚机构随后延伸到帝国的所有部分。与拿破仑法国作战的挑战——这一挑战改造了欧洲大部分地区的国家结构——强化了俄罗斯国家，扩大了其预算、税收和人员，扩充了其军队，并把一个深度强制性的国家锁定在位。

Catherine the Great completed the incorporation of the Ukraine by abolishing the semi-autonomous Hetmanate outright. The same bureaucracy then reached all parts of the empire. The challenge of war with Napoleonic France, which transformed state structure through much of Europe, fortified the Russian state, magnified its budget, taxation, and staff, expanded its military, and locked into place a deeply coercive state.

俄罗斯、波兰、匈牙利、塞尔维亚和勃兰登堡的国家以大体相似的方式形成，其基础是：以战争为业的诸侯与武装地主之间的牢固联盟；向贵族和乡绅大幅度让渡政府权力；对农民的共同剥削；以及商人资本的活动空间受到限制。屡见不鲜的是，缺乏资本的征服力量领袖把战利品和土地分给追随者，结果却要面对约束由此产生的武士兼大地主的问题。蒙古人是突出的例外，因为他们很少定居下来经营自己的土地，而通常继续靠以毁灭性入侵的永久威胁所勒索的贡赋为生。

In broadly similar ways, Russian, Polish, Hungarian, Serbian, and Brandenburger states formed on the basis of strong alliances between warmaking princes and armed landlords, large concessions of governmental power to nobles and gentry, joint exploitation of the peasantry, and restricted scope for merchant capital. Repeatedly, leaders of conquering forces who lacked capital offered their followers booty and land, only to face the problem of containing the great warrior-landlords they thereby created. Mongols stood out as exceptions because they rarely settled down to run their own lands, and usually continued to live on tribute exacted by the perpetual threat of devastating invasion.

尽管王室与贵族的相对分量（因而也就是战争在多大程度上创造了持久的国家结构）各国之间差异很大，所有这些国家都因严重依赖赤裸裸的强制而有别于其欧洲邻国。当16世纪大量东欧谷物开始向西流动时，现有的控制结构使大地主能够直接从这些货运中获利；他们利用国家权力遏制商人、强制农民生产者，并在这一过程中建立了一种新的农奴制。在那种权力平衡中，即使广泛的商业化也没有建立起城市、一个独立的资本家阶级，或者一个更像城市欧洲诸国的国家。

Although the relative weight of crown and nobility (and therefore the extent to which warfare created durable state structure) varied significantly from state to state, all these states stood out from their European neighbors by heavy reliance on brute coercion. When, in the sixteenth century, large volumes of eastern European grain began to flow westward, the existing structure of control permitted great landlords to profit directly from those shipments; they used state power to contain merchants and coerce peasant producers, building a new serfdom in the process. In that balance of power, even extensive commercialization did not build cities, an independent capitalist class, or a state more greatly resembling those of urban Europe.
西西里的经历与东欧列强的经历有着奇特的平行之处。几个世纪里，西西里是一个粮仓，是整个地中海谷物的丰富来源。然而，其阿拉伯和诺曼统治者把一套与在军事上活跃的地主结盟的制度强加于该岛，几乎不给城市和资本家留下空间。1208年掌权的腓特烈二世国王使城市屈从于他那个荣耀的国家。丹尼斯·麦克·史密斯（Dennis Mack Smith）记述道，“腓特烈使城镇屈服”
有助于确保从来不存在任何独立而强健、足以抗衡地主贵族的商人阶层或市政官员阶层；而这种对贵族缺乏挑战的状况，成为西西里政治、文化和经济衰落的根本因素之一。每当强有力的政府失效时，填补权力真空的是贵族而非本地城市。因此，支配西西里商业的是外来的城市——比萨、热那亚、威尼斯、阿马尔菲、卢卡。
（Mack Smith 1968a: 56）
这种对商业的外部控制持续了六个世纪，结果是农业富饶的西西里始终资本匮乏，并受制于强制控制。

The experience of Sicily curiously parallels that of eastern European powers. Sicily was for centuries a breadbasket, a rich source of grain for all the Mediterranean. Yet its Arab and Norman rulers clamped on the island a system of alliance with militarily-active landlords that left little scope for cities and capitalists. King Frederick II, who came to power in 1208, subordinated cities to his glorious state. "Frederick's subjection of the towns," reports Dennis Mack Smith,

helped to ensure that there was never any class of merchants or civic officials independent and vigorous enough to offset the landowning aristocracy; and this lack of challenge to the aristocracy was to be a fundamental factor in the political, cultural and economic decline of Sicily. Whenever strong government failed, it was the nobles and not the local cities which filled the vacuum of power. It was therefore foreign towns - Pisa, Genoa, Venice, Amalfi, Lucca - which dominated Sicilian commerce.
(Mack Smith 1968a: 56)
That external control over commerce continued for six centuries, with the result that an agriculturally rich Sicily remained capital-poor and subject to coercive control.

我们开始看到强制密集型国家形成诸路径之中一种齐一与变异并存的格局。欧洲所有高强制地区都以两种条件的某种组合为开端：（1）驱逐一个收取贡赋的政权的重大努力；（2）城市稀少、集中的资本很少。驱逐贡赋收取者在北欧诸国相对不重要；伊比利亚半岛和西西里的城市与资本规模则大于东欧和北欧。但无论在何处，这种组合都促成了这样一种征服策略：领地领主们同时既联合起来对抗共同的敌人，又为在各自领地内取得优先地位而相互争斗，其中为首的领主把对土地和劳动力的控制让渡给同侪，以换取军事援助。总的来说，这一策略几乎不为一个自主的资产阶级留出空间，因而也不为国家之外的资本积累与集中留出空间。

We begin to see a pattern of uniformity and variation among coercion-intensive paths of state formation. All Europe's areas of high coercion began with some combination of two conditions: (1) a major effort to expel a tribute-taking power, (2) few cities and little concentrated capital. The expulsion of tribute takers was relatively unimportant in the Nordic countries, the extent of cities and capital greater in the Iberian peninsula and Sicily than in eastern and northern Europe. But everywhere the combination encouraged a strategy of conquest in which territorial lords simultaneously leagued together against common enemies and fought each other for priority within their own territory, with the leading lord ceding control over land and labor to his fellows in exchange for military assistance. On the whole, that strategy left little space for an autonomous bourgeoisie, hence for accumulation and concentration of capital outside the state.

差异正从这里开始。在一些地区（波兰和匈牙利是显而易见的例子），武士贵族保有很大的权力，包括拥立和废黜国王的能力。在另一些地区（瑞典和俄罗斯即为适例），单一权力设法通过构建一种国家官僚机构确立了优先地位，这种官僚机构给予贵族和教士相对于平民人口的巨大特权，却使他们献身于国家的服务。还有一些地区（西西里和卡斯蒂利亚可以想见），那些较富有、较有权势的成员居住在首都、靠来自远方庄园的收入和国家岁入为生的贵族，与深入各省、并依靠教士和地方贵族协助推行王室意志的国家官员共存。于是，主要的分野把第一种变体与另外两种区分开来——把敌对武装地主长期占上风的国家，与其中一方早已确立对所有其他各方之至上地位的国家区别开来。在所有这类国家中，国家都是在资本匮乏中成长起来的，用国家保障的特权换取国家的武装力量，并严重依赖强制来确保对王室要求的服从。

There the differences began. In some areas (Poland and Hungary are the obvious examples) warrior nobles retained great power, including the ability to install and depose kings. In others (Sweden and Russia are cases in point) a single power managed to establish priority by constructing a state bureaucracy that gave nobles and clergy great privileges with respect to the commoner population, but committed them to service of the state. In still others (Sicily and Castile come to mind), a nobility whose richer and more powerful members resided in the capital on incomes drawn from distant estates and state revenues coexisted with state officials who reached far into the provinces and relied on priests and local nobles for assistance in working the royal will. The big division, then, separated the first variant from the other two - marked off states in which rival armed landlords long held the upper hand from those in which one of them early established supremacy over all the others. In all of them, states grew up starved for capital, bartered state-guaranteed privileges for national armed force, and relied heavily on coercion to assure compliance with royal demands.

这与佛兰德或北意大利诸国形成了何等鲜明的对照！试看上亚得里亚海，即从拉韦纳到的里雅斯特的那道弧形海岸线。几个世纪里，威尼斯在经济上和政治上都支配着这一地区。但在其南面，敌对列强为控制沿海地带而争斗。例如，拉韦纳曾是罗马和哥特皇帝的驻地，在公元1000年前后是一个共和国，直到14、15世纪才归威尼斯控制，此后直到意大利复兴运动一直属于教皇的领地。在其西面，一个由多个城邦组成的地区屈服于威尼斯14世纪的征服，使威尼斯这个城市帝国与伦巴底有了共同的边界，而伦巴底先是一个独立国家，随后先后成为西班牙、奥地利和统一后的意大利的属地。在其北面，神圣罗马帝国及其继承国始终赫然在侧，有时还占据着海岸。在其东面，一个又一个帝国涌起并向亚得里亚海推进。在公元990年，拜占庭帝国在达尔马提亚和威尼斯地区行使名义上的控制，而一个以中欧为基地、面目模糊的“罗马”帝国则声称对意大利的相邻部分拥有主权。

What a contrast with the states of Flanders or northern Italy! Consider the upper Adriatic, the arc of coastline from Ravenna to Trieste. For centuries, Venice dominated the region both economically and politically. But to the south rival powers struggled for control of the coastal area. Ravenna, for example, having been the residence of Roman and Goth emperors, passed the Millennium as a republic, only came under Venetian control during the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, and from then until the Risorgimento belonged to the pope's domains. To the west, a region of multiple city-states yielded to Venice's fourteenth-century conquests, giving the Venetian city-empire a common frontier with a Lombardy that was first an independent state, then a possession successively of Spain, Austria, and unified Italy. To the north, the Holy Roman Empire and its successor states always loomed large, and sometimes held the coast. To the east, empire after empire surged and pushed toward the Adriatic. In the year 990, the Byzantine Empire exercised nominal control in Dalmatia and the Venetian region, while a shadowy "Roman" empire based in central Europe claimed sovereignty in the adjacent sections of Italy.
为了简化一个极为复杂的故事，让我们集中考察威尼斯，只简要提及该城与所有那些竞争性权力的互动。我们要寻找的是：可观的、不断增长的资本集中与薄弱的、碎裂的强制集中之间的互动；资本家对任何建立自主强制权力的尝试所施加的深刻影响；一个精干、高效、贪婪、以保护为取向的海洋国家的出现；这个国家最终被更大的陆上列强所围困；简言之，资本密集型国家形成的精髓。

To simplify a very complicated story, let us concentrate on Venice, and simply note the city's interactions with all those competing powers. We shall look for: the interaction between substantial, increasing concentrations of capital and weak, fragmented concentrations of coercion; the profound influence of capitalists over any attempt to create autonomous coercive power; the emergence of a sleek, efficient, rapacious, protection-oriented seafaring state; the eventual hemming-in of that state by larger land-based powers; in short, the quintessence of capital-intensive state formation.

伦巴第人入侵意大利（公元568年）促使零散的船夫和制盐者形成一批与意大利本土联系紧密的难民聚落。威尼斯在名义上仍是拜占庭帝国的一部分，而伦巴第人以及随后的法兰克人夺取了附近的大部分领土。到公元990年，随着拜占庭帝国达到鼎盛，威尼斯主要充当转运站，转运拜占庭体系内的商人发往北意大利的货物；该城派出自己的商人前往帕维亚和其他内陆市场，用盐、鱼和来自东方的珍贵货物交换谷物及其他必需品。然而，随着他们转向海上，威尼斯商人在其货品中增加了奴隶和木材。他们还把该城的商业和政治影响扩展到亚得里亚海的大部分地区。

The Lombard invasion of Italy (AD 568) had transformed a scattering of boatmen and saltmakers into a set of refugee settlements with strong ties to mainland Italy. Venice remained a nominal part of the Byzantine Empire while Lombards and then Franks seized much of the nearby territory. Up to AD 990, as the Byzantine Empire reached its high point, Venice served chiefly as a transfer station for goods dispatched to northern Italy by traders within the Byzantine system; the city sent its own merchants to Pavia and other inland markets, exchanging salt, fish, and precious goods from the East for grain and other necessities. As they turned seaward, however, Venetian merchants added slaves and lumber to their wares. They also extended the city's commercial and political influence to much of the Adriatic.

在当时的那个地中海世界里，造船和航海技术的局限意味着船只紧贴海岸航行，沿着为数不多、由风向、洋流和浅滩所决定的航线行进，频繁靠岸补充淡水和其他给养，一旦遭遇海盗船便难以脱身，而在进行长途航行时，只有运输贵重货物才合算（Pryor 1988）。没有哪个国家能在其本土之外的许多港口不享有广泛特权而成为海上强国。那些确实控制了许多港口的国家从这些港口获得三重回报：进入长途贸易路线的通道、在这些港口中的贸易，以及把这些港口用作海盗船劫掠他国商业的基地。威尼斯在一段时间内满足了这些条件，成为地中海最强大的海上力量。它对基督教国家从穆斯林手中夺取主要海上航道贡献甚巨——这一过程始于10世纪，直到14世纪土耳其人推进时才有所退却。只有15、16世纪奥斯曼权力的巩固，才严重损害了西方对地中海航道的支配（Pryor 1988: 172-8）。

In the Mediterranean of that time, the limits of shipbuilding and navigation meant that ships hugged shores, followed a relatively small number of routes defined by winds, currents, and shoals, put in frequently for water and other supplies, evaded corsairs with difficulty once they encountered them, and when they traveled long distances could only afford to carry valuable goods (Pryor 1988). No state became a great maritime power without having extensive privileges in many ports away from its home territory. States that did control many ports gained from them a triple return: access to long trade routes, trade in those ports, and use of the ports as bases for corsairs to prey on the commerce of other powers. For a time, Venice met these conditions and became the Mediterranean's greatest seapower. It contributed mightily to the Christian states' capture of major sea lanes from Muslim control, which began in the tenth century and did not recede until the Turkish advances of the fourteenth. Only the consolidation of Ottoman power during the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries seriously compromised Western domination of Mediterranean sea-lanes (Pryor 1988: 172-8).

在11世纪，威尼斯的舰队开始既把其贸易带入地中海，又击退争夺亚得里亚海控制权的对手——达尔马提亚人、匈牙利人、萨拉森人和诺曼人。威尼斯军队于990年兼并了达尔马提亚，但在1100年前后把它丢给了正在扩张的匈牙利国家；此后五个世纪里，他们支配着达尔马提亚的商业活动，但其政治控制却随着东面领土国家的扩张与收缩而盛衰起伏。由于他们与拜占庭皇帝合作对后者的敌人作战，他们在帝国内获得了特殊的贸易特权，包括在君士坦丁堡拥有自己的街区（1082）。如同斯堪的纳维亚和北德意志的汉萨商人一样，威尼斯商人逐渐经营起拜占庭的大部分长途贸易。在12世纪，他们把自己的活动范围扩展到整个东地中海，有利可图地把贸易、海盗活动、征服和参与十字军结合在一起。由于十字军运动本身就把贸易、海盗活动和征服结合起来，这些活动相互补充。到1102年，威尼斯在西顿有了自己的商人街区；到1123年，它又在提尔建立了一个基地。

During the eleventh century, Venice's fleet began both to carry its trade into the Mediterranean and to fight off rivals for control of the Adriatic - Dalmatians, Hungarians, Saracens, and Normans. Venetian forces annexed Dalmatia in the year 990, but lost it to an expanding Hungarian state around 1100; for five centuries thereafter, they dominated Dalmatia's commercial activity, but waxed and waned in its political control as a function of expansion and contraction of territorial states to the east. For their collaboration with the Byzantine emperor in wars against his enemies, they received exceptional trading privileges in the empire, including their own quarter in Constantinople (1082). Like Hanse merchants in Scandinavia and North Germany, Venetian traders came to manage much of Byzantium's long-distance commerce. During the twelfth century, they expanded their scope to the whole eastern Mediterranean, profitably mixing trade, piracy, conquest, and participation in crusades. Since crusading itself combined trade, piracy, and conquest, the activities complemented each other. By 1102, Venice had its own merchant quarter in Sidon; by 1123 it had established a base in Tyre as well.
在1203年和1204年，威尼斯从其组合策略中得到了回报：一位狡黠的总督把一支十字军引向君士坦丁堡，给拜占庭帝国以致命一击。在君士坦丁堡夺取的圣马可青铜马，至今仍是那一绝技的纪念碑。威尼斯最终控制了这个已覆灭帝国的很大部分（在法律上为八分之三）。该城随后把希腊群岛上的封地授予其大家族成员，条件是他们要保持贸易路线的畅通。

In 1203 and 1204 Venice received the payoff on its combined strategy, as a crafty doge diverted a crusade to Constantinople and delivered a death blow to the Byzantine Empire. The bronze horses of San Marco, seized in Constantinople, still stand as monuments to that
tour de force.

Venice ended up in control of large pieces (legally, three eighths) of the late empire. The city then granted fiefs in the Greek islands to members of its great families, on condition that they keep the trade routes open.
在所有这些征服之中，威尼斯的商业利益始终至高无上。该城的显要家族是商人和银行家，城市的议事会代表这些显要家族，总督出自同一个贵族阶层，城市的军事力量取自本城人口，而其军事和外交政策所促进的是建立商业垄断、保护其商人、把贸易引导经由威尼斯，而不是创建一个领土帝国。一旦巩固了优越地位，威尼斯当局便不愿再容忍海盗活动、也不愿再发放私掠许可证，因为二者都会危及他们在和平商业中的投资。

Through all the conquest, Venetian commercial interests reigned supreme. The city's leading families were merchants and bankers, the city's governing council represented the leading families, the doge came from that same patriciate, the city's military forces drew on its own population, and its military and diplomatic policies promoted the establishment of commercial monopolies, protection for its merchants, and channeling of trade through Venice rather than the creation of a territorial empire. Once they consolidated their superior position, Venetian authorities became reluctant to tolerate piracy and license privateers, since both would menace their investment in peaceful commerce.

该城的海上支配地位又为安全运送货物和人员开辟了新的获利机会。威尼斯船主靠运送十字军、随后又运送朝圣者前往圣地而致富。1203年运送十字军前往君士坦丁堡的运费，“约相当于英格兰国王年收入的两倍”（Scammell 1981: 108）。此外，尽管为十字军和朝圣者提供了这些服务，威尼斯的统治者却毫不犹豫地与基督教世界的敌人打交道。例如，在的黎波里（1289）和阿克（1291）落入奥斯曼突厥人之手后，威尼斯立即与奥斯曼人谈判订立条约，以保留其原有的贸易权利。

The city's maritime dominance, in its turn, opened new opportunities for profit in transporting goods and people safely. Venetian shippers grew rich by carrying crusaders, and then pilgrims, to the Holy Land. Freight charges on the transport of crusaders to Constantinople in 1203, "came to about twice the annual income of the king of England" (Scammell 1981: 108). For all their service of crusaders and pilgrims, furthermore, Venetian rulers did not hesitate to deal with the enemies of Christendom. After Tripoli (1289) and Acre (1291) fell to the Ottoman Turks, for example, Venice immediately negotiated a treaty with the Ottomans for retention of their old trading rights.

在亚得里亚海内，敌对城市若无领土强国的帮助便无法与威尼斯抗衡。例如，的里雅斯特和拉古萨同样是享有某种独立的贸易城市，但没有外援就无法遏制威尼斯。威尼斯于1203年征服了的里雅斯特，并在一百多年里不安稳地役使着这个港口。在的里雅斯特1368年失败的叛乱中，威尼斯的宿敌、觊觎一个亚得里亚海出海口的奥地利公爵利奥波德派出了一支救援部队。1382年，的里雅斯特成功地把自己置于利奥波德的宗主权之下；此后直到20世纪，的里雅斯特一直属于奥地利（事实上一直是奥地利的主要港口）。

Within the Adriatic, rival cities were unable to hold their own against Venice without the aid of territorial powers. Trieste and Ragusa, for example, were likewise trading cities that enjoyed a certain independence, but they could not check Venice without outside help. Venice conquered Trieste in 1203, and held the port in uneasy thrall for more than a century. During Trieste's unsuccessful rebellion of 1368, Duke Leopold of Austria, an old enemy of Venice who coveted an opening onto the Adriatic, sent a relieving force. In 1382, Trieste succeeded in placing itself under Leopold's overlordship; Trieste then remained Austrian (indeed, remained Austria's principal port) until the twentieth century.

拉古萨／杜布罗夫尼克遵循了一种大体相似的策略。拉古萨直到1358年都处于威尼斯名义上的宗主权之下，但在此之前通过培育与邻邦塞尔维亚王国和波斯尼亚王国的良好关系而保持了相对独立，其商人在这些国家的贸易中扮演着支配角色。一个正在扩张的匈牙利在1350年代把威尼斯逐出达尔马提亚，并授予拉古萨在其帝国边缘近乎独立的地位。随着奥斯曼突厥人在1460年代赢得巴尔干，拉古萨的商人贵族设法与新的穆斯林统治者谈判达成了类似的安排。拉古萨因其历任保护者而免遭意大利人的征服，又因其商业地位而在斯拉夫和奥斯曼帝国之内获得高度自治的保障，直到1808年拿破仑入侵为止，它一直作为一个实质上独立的城邦运作。

Ragusa/Dubrovnik followed a broadly similar strategy. Ragusa lived under nominal Venetian overlordship until 1358, but maintained relative independence before then by cultivating good relations with the neighboring kingdoms of Serbia and Bosnia, in whose trade its merchants played a dominant role. An expanding Hungary expelled Venice from Dalmatia in the 1350s, and granted Ragusa a nearly independent position at the periphery of its empire. As Ottoman Turks won the Balkans in the 1460s, the merchant-patricians of Ragusa managed to negotiate similar arrangements with the new Muslim rulers. Shielded from Italian conquest by its successive protectors and guaranteed great autonomy within Slavic and Ottoman empires by its commercial position, Ragusa operated as an essentially independent city-state until the Napoleonic invasion of 1808.

尽管那些补给线受威尼斯支配的意大利城市、以及那些受威尼斯直接控制的达尔马提亚城市，不断挣扎着要遏制威尼斯的霸权，威尼斯在海上力量上最直接的竞争者却是热那亚——一个类似的远洋城邦。在13世纪后期，热那亚穿越西地中海向外扩张，越过直布罗陀沿大西洋海岸推进，其方式正如威尼斯深入东地中海和黑海；但热那亚向东推进得比威尼斯向西更为有效；两个强国尤其在其海上区域的交汇点上发生冲突。13世纪后期热那亚对黑海的控制，阻断了威尼斯通往那项有利可图的贸易的通道——那项贸易经蒙古人控制的领土从特拉比松通往中国。然而，一旦威尼斯军队在基奥贾潟湖封锁并俘获了热那亚舰队（1380），威尼斯便在东方占据了优先地位。

Although the Italian cities whose supply lines Venice dominated and the Dalmatian cities over whom Venice exercised direct control struggled continually to check Venetian hegemony, Venice competed for seapower most directly with Genoa, a similar ocean-going city-state. During the later thirteenth century, Genoa expanded through the western Mediterranean and out past Gibraltar along the Atlantic coast in the same way that Venice penetrated the eastern Mediterranean and the Black Sea; but Genoa reached more effectively east than Venice reached west; the two powers clashed especially at the meeting points of their maritime zones. Genoese control of the Black Sea during the later thirteenth century blocked Venetian access to the lucrative trade with that which passed from Trebizond to China through Mongol-held territory. Once Venetian forces blockaded and captured the Genoese fleet in Chioggia's lagoon (1380), however, Venice held priority in the east.

公元1000年之后，随着威尼斯在亚得里亚海和东地中海贸易中的地位日益扩大，该城人口跃居欧洲最大之列：1200年有80,000或更多，1300年约有120,000。尽管黑死病（由从卡法返航的热那亚桨帆船传入意大利）在1347、1348和1349年夺去了该城一半以上的人口，此后几个世纪里居民人数一直在120,000上下摆动，事实上直到今天。自13世纪起，制造业和商业取代航海成为该城的主导活动。但威尼斯仍然是海上贸易的关键环节，也是海上政治中的一个强国。例如，其帝国一直延伸到塞浦路斯（至1573年）和克里特（至1669年）。该城的军队为维持获取商业机会的通道而战，也为抵御热那亚之类的对手而战。最重要的是，其统治者因能够以对该城商人、银行家和制造商相对较低的成本，进行精明而成功的海战，而赢得声誉。

After the Millennium, as Venice's place in the trade of the Adriatic and eastern Mediterranean grew ever larger, the city's population bounded to one of Europe's greatest: 80,000 or more in 1200, 120,000 or so in 1300. Although the Black Death (introduced into Italy by Genoese galleys returning from Caffa) killed over half the city's population in 1347, 1348, and 1349, the number of inhabitants swung around 120,000 for centuries thereafter, in fact until now. From the thirteenth century onward, manufacturing and commerce displaced seafaring as the city's dominant activities. But Venice remained a critical link in maritime trade, and a great power in maritime politics. Its empire extended, for example, to Cyprus until 1573 and to Crete until 1669. The city's forces warred to maintain access to commercial opportunities, and warred to hold off such rivals as Genoa. More than anything else, its rulers gained reputations from the ability to wage canny and successful sea wars at relatively low cost to the city's merchants, bankers, and manufacturers.

威尼斯贸易的性质有利于造就一个格外柔韧而掠夺成性的国家。与靠运输谷物、盐和葡萄酒等笨重产品致富的荷兰人不同，威尼斯人专注于价格高昂的奢侈品：香料、丝绸、奴隶。此外，他们还经常运送大量金银。因此，效率、垄断以及免遭劫掠者侵扰的军事保护，对其成功至关重要。G. V. 斯卡梅尔（G. V. Scammell）评论道，“尽管其他帝国强权可能会把大部分精力和资源用于保卫某种特定的垄断，但除了威尼斯之外，没有任何一国实际上把经营和保护这种垄断作为自身存在的全部目的，由国家为其经营提供船只，并以一支海军和一个帝国保障这种垄断的安全”（Scammell 1981: 116）。这样一个国家尽可能少地打仗，但打起来却毫不留情。

The nature of Venetian trade facilitated creation of an exceptionally supple and predatory state. Unlike the Dutch, who gained their riches transporting bulky products such as grain, salt, and wine, Venetians concentrated on high-priced luxuries: spices, silks, slaves. What is more, they frequently carried great quantities of bullion. Efficiency, monopoly, and military protection from marauders therefore became crucial to their success. "[T]hough other imperial powers might devote much of their energies and resources to the defence of some particular monopoly," remarks G. V. Scammell, "with none, except Venice, did its running and protection become in effect the whole purpose of their being, with the state providing the ships for its operation and a navy and empire for its safeguard" (Scammell 1981: 116). Such a state made as little war as possible, but made that war ruthlessly.

尤其是总督们承担着战争的责任。最初的总督是拜占庭帝国的臣仆。随着威尼斯确立其独立于帝国，总督们越来越像经选举产生、此后便行使主权的君主，行事不经过共同体的正式协商，并在自己的王朝内部指定继承人。然而，随着公元990年以后该城的成长，威尼斯日益走向正式的寡头制。由大家族在其中起主导作用的大会选举总督。他必须咨询一个议事会，该议事会在理论上代表由潟湖所有定居点组成的公社，在实践中则代表中央定居点的大家族。情况往往如此：当一位想要成为君主的人面对一群界定明确而利益相异的势力、没有他们的支持便无法统治时，一个正式的议事会就成形了。随着时间推移，大议事会变得越来越排他；1297年，其成员资格实质上成为世袭的。1300年和1310年，议事会击退了反对把非贵族排除在其议事之外的民众叛乱。自此以后，寡头集团的成员在城市内部争夺显赫地位，但从未放弃对其命运的集体控制。

Doges, especially, bore responsibility for warfare. The first doges had been servitors of the Byzantine Empire. As Venice established its independence from the empire, doges had acted increasingly like elected but thenceforth sovereign princes, acting without formal consultation of the community and designating their successors from within their own dynasties. With the city's growth after AD 990, however, Venice moved increasingly to formal oligarchy. A general assembly in which the great families played a preponderant role elected the doge. He had to consult a council that, in theory, represented the Commune formed by all the settlements of the lagoons and, in practice, spoke for the great families in the central settlement. As is so often the case, a formal council took shape when a would-be sovereign faced a group of well-defined and disparate interests without whose support he could not govern. Over time, the great council became more and more exclusive; in 1297, membership became essentially hereditary. In 1300 and 1310, the council fought off popular rebellions against the exclusion of non-patricians from its deliberations. From that point on, members of the oligarchy struggled for preeminence within the city, but never relinquished collective control over its destiny.

事实上，接连不断的权力斗争所产生的并不是单一的治理议事会，而是一个变动不居的议事会等级体系，从总督自己的顾问一直到全体居民的大会，后者此时已沦落到批准其上位者之决定的地步。另一方面，威尼斯并未产生官僚机构；选举产生的委员会和官员的私人随从承担了大部分政府工作。到1200年，总督与其说是由民众欢呼选出的独裁者，不如说是寡头集团的行政官员。结果，商人资本家的利益支配了威尼斯国家的政策——无论内政还是外交。

Rather than a single governing council, indeed, successive struggles over power produced a shifting hierarchy of councils, from the doge's own advisors to the general assembly of all inhabitants, the latter now reduced to ratifying the decisions of their betters. On the other hand, Venice secreted no bureaucracy; elected committees and officials' personal retainers did the bulk of governmental work. By 1200, the doge had become rather the oligarchy's executive officer than an autocrat chosen by popular acclamation. As a result, the interests of merchant capitalists dominated the policy - domestic and foreign - of the Venetian state.
如果说商业利益引导着威尼斯，那么国家反过来也规制其公民的商业活动。丹尼尔·韦利（Daniel Waley）评论道，“前往黎凡特做生意的威尼斯人”

很可能乘坐国家建造的桨帆船，由一名国家选定的船长指挥，在一支由国家组织的船队中航行；当他抵达亚历山大或阿克时，很可能奉命与其他威尼斯人一起，参加一次由国家组织的棉花或胡椒的联合采购。后一种制度的好处是，如果威尼斯人彼此不相互竞争，价格就能压得更低。长途航行的船队制度至少可以追溯到12世纪。到13世纪，常规安排已允许每年有两支桨帆船队前往东地中海；到14世纪初，还有每年开往英格兰和佛兰德、开往北非（“巴巴里”）以及开往艾格莫尔特（罗讷河口附近）的航行。国家造船厂（arsenal）可追溯到13世纪初，那里使用的材料通常由威尼斯共和国直接购买。
